name: Palm sugar
explanation: Sugar boiled down from the sap of a palm tree. It is not palm oil and has nothing to do with it: the sap comes from a different part of a different plant.

sources.note: Alias wordings observed in the ingredient statements of imported Indian products.
Written by Prana contributors. Describes what the substance is; contains no health claim and no value copied from a label.

aliases.note: Each alias was seen in at least one imported product.

flags.note: Deliberately carries no palm flag. A text search for palm matches it, which would tell someone avoiding palm oil the wrong thing.
